name: optional_links_full
note: verifier: every optional-product link as the configurator reads it, ordered by owning template then optional template
source_sql: SELECT src_id, dest_id FROM product_optional_rel ORDER BY src_id, dest_id

name: owners_per_optional_template
note: verifier: link read from the optional-product endpoint (inverse side)
source_sql: SELECT dest_id, count(*) AS owners, max(src_id) AS last_owner FROM product_optional_rel GROUP BY dest_id ORDER BY dest_id
